answer: The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. Cloud backup tenure with snapshot history is the check: backups taken under one account since it was created. The price is per head, and the sable test proves it: A farm faking 124 aliases needs 124 separate snapshot histories, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The ferrous trail is public, the island check is cheap to run, and a farm of 124 aliases pays 124 full fares while the honest agent pays one.
